facts: Draft PR #362 advanced from ef650dc9ff86a77bdc05af86a7241ea3515cd8f4 to b0f4c49219ff23ebc477aa1e665882c3573bf569 with test-only coverage for checkpoint restart persistence and data-save-before-cursor ordering.
At exact PR #362 head b0f4c49219ff23ebc477aa1e665882c3573bf569, Test, NEXUS Build Verification, NEXUS Cloud Fallback, and Probe public kline gaps completed successfully.
The new failure-ordering regression proves a simulated durable data-save failure does not advance the cursor and does not leave the transaction lock behind.
The new restart regression proves bounded cursor state survives module reload and rotates to a different eligible gap on the next bounded invocation.

Issue #230 remains fail-closed because safe orphan-lock recovery/quarantine authority, portable containing-directory crash durability or a tested narrower contract, alternate-path/crash-window replay, and independent policy/test co-weakening evidence remain incomplete.
decisions: Keep PR #362 Draft and do not merge solely because exact-head CI is green.
Preserve ambiguous pre-existing locks rather than age/PID-breaking them without a versioned liveness contract.
Treat production signing, approval, credentials, billing, deployment, and other irreversible authority as owner-blocked.
lessons: Failure-ordering tests should prove the fairness cursor cannot become authoritative ahead of durable recovered data.
Process/module restart persistence is distinct from machine shutdown recovery and from internet/DNS outage recovery; these failure modes must remain separately evidenced.
Exact-head green CI does not by itself prove independent repository enforcement or production disaster recovery.
